prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: one dedicated NPC dialogue portrait for a Chinese wuxia RPG.
Image 1 is ONLY a rendering STYLE reference: realistic thick-painted facial
modelling, substantial natural fabric, dimensional skin and quiet warm light.
Create a NEW man, not the escort guard's exact face, headwrap or casual clothes.

Subject: the mature Luoyang south-gate clerk, a Chinese man aged 40 to 50.
Clearly middle-aged face with restrained crow's-feet, a short neat moustache
and closely trimmed short beard, observant eyes and a composed, businesslike
expression. Calm civic authority, not angry, smiling, youthful or heroic glamour.
Costume: modest dark-navy Ming-inspired gate-clerk official robe and structured
dark official cap, with practical restrained leather shoulder protection.
The cap must be recognizably an official cap, NOT a cloth headwrap, bandana or
forehead band. Worn navy fabric, simple collar and sober leather; no dragon robe,
emperor's crown, lavish general's plate armour, oversized pauldrons or gold finery.

Composition: square 1:1 head-and-chest portrait, one man facing front and looking
toward the viewer. Full cap and shoulders inside the frame with comfortable
margins; chest cropped naturally at the lower edge. Clear facial features and
readable official attire at dialogue-portrait scale.
Background: softly blurred grey-brick Luoyang city gateway, understated and
lower-contrast than the subject; no crowd, signs, scenery panorama or extra person.
Medium and light: realistic hand-painted thick-paint game portrait matching the
reference's material depth, subtle brushwork, natural skin and navy-cloth texture,
gentle upper-left daylight. Not a photograph, anime, cel shading, Hong Kong comic
ink, exaggerated line art or chibi cartoon.
No text, lettering, symbols, UI, frame, watermark, blood, weapons, village farmer
clothing, straw hat, teenage face or decorative red headband. One finished portrait.
